versions.changelog:
Initial release of MyBooks TTS skill (v0.1.0):

- Supports converting EPUB ebooks to audiobooks using MiMo TTS or OpenAI-compatible API.
- Includes tools for TTS API configuration, connection testing, starting conversion, and progress querying.
- Provides management of custom cloned voice libraries (upload, list, delete, preview).
- Enables management of custom voice prompts (save, list, delete).
- All operations require administrator credentials via environment variables.
